vibe_rationale: Famous party-race with a bike show, live music and camping, run with a trail nonprofit; a strong community core in a single scene.
fit_notes: Adult endurance riders on a race-party weekend, with a clear recovery, hydration and post-ride wellness fit. Four partners plus a 2025 presenting brand, a partnership page and a named partnerships contact. Most sponsors are series-wide, so a California-specific deal is untested. US-based.
